records.jp: なんだか、不思議だよね
records.en_original: Isn't it strange?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't it strange?
records.en: Isn't it strange?

records.jp: 何が？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 風に当たるだけで電気が作られるなんてさ
records.en_original: That this thing can turn wind into electricity.
records.en_auxiliary: That this thing can turn wind into electricity.
records.en: That this thing can turn wind into electricity.

records.jp: 理屈では仕組みを理解したつもりなんだけど、<CR>こうやって見ると……やっぱり、うーん
records.en_original: Like, I know how it works in theory, but looking at it like this...
records.en_auxiliary: Like, I know how it works in theory, but looking at it like this...
records.en: Like, I know how it works in theory,<CR>but looking at it like this...

records.jp: 手回し発電機なら分かるんだけどね
records.en_original: I get how hand generators work though...
records.en_auxiliary: I get how hand generators work though...
records.en: I get how hand generators work though...

records.jp: そうそう！　あれは発電してるって感じがするよね。<CR>手を動かしてるからかなぁ
records.en_original: Exactly! You have to wind those by hand, so you can feel the electricity being generated.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! You have to wind those by hand, so you can feel the electricity being generated.
records.en: Exactly! You have to wind those by hand, so you can feel the<CR>electricity being generated.

records.jp: 私あれも興味あるんだよね。<CR>発電できるフィットネスバイク
records.en_original: I like those bicycle-powered generators too.
records.en_auxiliary: I like those bicycle-powered generators too.
records.en: I like those bicycle-powered<CR>generators too.

records.jp: トレーニングでも使えるし、頑張った分だけ<CR>電気が貯まるし、一石二鳥！
records.en_original: You can generate electricity while you exercise. It's two birds with one stone!
records.en_auxiliary: You can generate electricity while you exercise. It's two birds with one stone!
records.en: You can generate electricity while you exercise.<CR>It's two birds with one stone!

records.jp: 日菜子さんが頑張ったら百人力だよ
records.en_original: You'd be able to generate a hundred people's worth of electricity, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: You'd be able to generate a hundred people's worth of electricity, Hinako.
records.en: You'd be able to generate a hundred people's worth of electricity, Hinako-san.

records.jp: まぁでも、この学校全部の電気を賄うのは<CR>難しいだろうなぁ
records.en_original: Still, it'd be hard to generate enough to power the whole school.
records.en_auxiliary: Still, it'd be hard to generate enough to power the whole school.
records.en: Still, it'd be hard to generate enough to power<CR>the whole school.

records.jp: いいよねぇ。私も風に当たるだけで発電して、<CR>褒められたい
records.en_original: I wish I could generate electricity just by standing in the wind and have everyone praise me for it.
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I could generate electricity just by standing in the wind and have everyone praise me for it.
records.en: I wish I could generate electricity just by standing in the wind and have everyone<CR>praise me for it.

records.jp: あはは、そう来るか
records.en_original: Ahaha, I've never thought about that.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I've never thought about that.
records.en: Ahaha, I've never thought about that.

records.jp: でも雨の日も、強風の日も<CR>立ってないといけないんだよ？
records.en_original: But wouldn't you have to stand outside on rainy days and really blustery days too?
records.en_auxiliary: But wouldn't you have to stand outside on rainy days and really blustery days too?
records.en: But wouldn't you have to stand outside<CR>on rainy days and really blustery days too?

records.jp: それはきびしい
records.en_original: That would be rough.
records.en_auxiliary: That would be rough.
records.en: That would be rough.

records.jp: 風力発電所って楽そうに見えるけど、<CR>意外と大変だと思うな～
records.en_original: Being a wind turbine sounds fun, but I think it'd actually be pretty hard.
records.en_auxiliary: Being a wind turbine sounds fun, but I think it'd actually be pretty hard.
records.en: Being a wind turbine may look easy,<CR>but I think it would be surprisingly difficult~

records.jp: そう考えると、これを作ってよかったね
records.en_original: When you put it that way, it's a good thing we built it.
records.en_auxiliary: When you put it that way, it's a good thing we built it.
records.en: When you put it that way, it's a good thing we built it.

records.jp: 今まででも生活できてはいたけど、<CR>やっぱりこういう施設があると安心だよね
records.en_original: We got by okay without it, but it's definitely nice to have a facility like this.
records.en_auxiliary: We got by okay without it, but it's definitely nice to have a facility like this.
records.en: We got by okay without it, but it's<CR>definitely nice to have a facility like this.

records.jp: そうだね。もし電気が使えなくなったら私……
records.en_original: You're right. Without electricity...
records.en_auxiliary: You're right. Without electricity...
records.en: You're right. Without electricity...

records.jp: 生活できないもん。<CR>スマホ自由に使えないとかマジできつい
records.en_original: I wouldn't be able to live. I can't imagine not being able to use my smartphone!
records.en_auxiliary: I wouldn't be able to live. I can't imagine not being able to use my smartphone!
records.en: I wouldn't be able to live.<CR>I can't imagine not being able to use my smartphone!

records.jp: あ、そっち？<CR>私、灯りとか冷房とかを思い浮かべてた
records.en_original: Your smartphone? I'd be more worried about the lights or the air conditioning.
records.en_auxiliary: Your smartphone? I'd be more worried about the lights or the air conditioning.
records.en: Your smartphone?<CR>I'd be more worried about the lights or the air conditioning.

records.jp: ドライヤーとかさ、女の子ばかりだから<CR>大変だったでしょ？　時間ずらしたりして
records.en_original: Or even hair dryers? Remember how tough it was when we had to take turns?
records.en_auxiliary: Or even hair dryers? Remember how tough it was when we had to take turns?
records.en: Or even hair dryers? Remember how<CR>tough it was when we had to take turns?

records.jp: そっか。そっちの方が大事か
records.en_original: You're right. Those are much bigger problems.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right. Those are much bigger problems.
records.en: You're right. Those are much bigger problems.

records.jp: 私は趣味で電化製品使うこともないからなぁ。<CR>通知来た時以外は、スマホもあまり見ないし
records.en_original: I don't spend that much time using electronics. I only look at my phone when I get a notification.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't spend that much time using electronics. I only look at my phone when I get a notification.
records.en: I don't really use electronics for hobbies.<CR>I barely look at my phone unless I get a notification.

records.jp: ああ、音楽聴けないのはちょっと嫌だけど<CR>そのくらいかなぁ
records.en_original: I guess I'd be sad if I couldn't listen to music, but that's about it.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I'd be sad if I couldn't listen to music, but that's about it.
records.en: I guess I'd be sad if I couldn't listen to music,<CR>but that's about it.

records.jp: （たしかに言われてみれば<CR>日菜子さんって結構アナログなイメージだな）
records.en_original: (Come to think of it, Hinako is definitely the unplugged type.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Come to think of it, Hinako is definitely the unplugged type.)
records.en: (Now that she mentions it,<CR>Hinako-san does have a rather analog image.)

records.jp: でも、生活するうえでは電気はいっぱい使ってる
records.en_original: But we definitely use a lot of electricity in our day-to-day lives.
records.en_auxiliary: But we definitely use a lot of electricity in our day-to-day lives.
records.en: But we definitely use a lot of electricity in our day-to-day lives.

records.jp: いや、意外となんとかなるかも。<CR>普段は基本的にごろごろしてるだけだし
records.en_original: Actually...I'd probably be fine. I spend most of the day just lying around anyway.
records.en_auxiliary: Actually...I'd probably be fine. I spend most of the day just lying around anyway.
records.en: Actually...I'd probably be fine.<CR>I spend most of the day just lying around anyway.

records.jp: それにこう見えて私、割と紙の本読むから。<CR>電化製品にそこまで依存してないと思う
records.en_original: And I actually read a lot of books. I'm not that addicted to electronics.
records.en_auxiliary: And I actually read a lot of books. I'm not that addicted to electronics.
records.en: And believe it or not, I read quite a few physical books.<CR>I don't think I'm that dependent on electronics.

records.jp: アニメ観れないよ
records.en_original: You wouldn't be able to watch anime.
records.en_auxiliary: You wouldn't be able to watch anime.
records.en: You wouldn't be able to watch anime.

records.jp: あ、無理でした
records.en_original: Ah. That won't do.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah. That won't do.
records.en: Ah. That won't do.

records.jp: そう考えるとこういう施設、もっとあるといいよね
records.en_original: When you think about it, we should have more facilities like this.
records.en_auxiliary: When you think about it, we should have more facilities like this.
records.en: When you think about it, we should have more facilities like this.

records.jp: たとえば？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 地熱発電所とか
records.en_original: Like a geothermal power plant.
records.en_auxiliary: Like a geothermal power plant.
records.en: Like a geothermal power plant.

records.jp: それってどこでもはできなかった気がするんだけど
records.en_original: You can't build those just anywhere, though.
records.en_auxiliary: You can't build those just anywhere, though.
records.en: You can't build those just anywhere, though.

records.jp: 探せばいいんだよ。掘って
records.en_original: We'd just have to dig!
records.en_auxiliary: We'd just have to dig!
records.en: We'd just have to dig!

records.jp: ええー？
records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: ついでに温泉出てきたら最高じゃん
records.en_original: We might find a hot spring in the process. It'd be great!
records.en_auxiliary: We might find a hot spring in the process. It'd be great!
records.en: We might find a hot spring in the process. It'd be great!

records.jp: 温泉かぁ。それは魅力的かも……
records.en_original: I wouldn't mind a hot spring...
records.en_auxiliary: I wouldn't mind a hot spring...
records.en: I wouldn't mind a hot spring...

records.jp: 水力発電所とか
records.en_original: Like a hydroelectric power plant.
records.en_auxiliary: Like a hydroelectric power plant.
records.en: Like a hydroelectric power plant.

records.jp: どうやって？
records.en_original: How would that work?
records.en_auxiliary: How would that work?
records.en: How would that work?

records.jp: プールに水車を設置するんだよ。<CR>そしたら、遊んでるうちに発電できるでしょ？
records.en_original: We could put a water wheel in the pool. It would generate electricity while we swim!
records.en_auxiliary: We could put a water wheel in the pool. It would generate electricity while we swim!
records.en: We install a waterwheel in the pool.<CR>Then we can generate electricity while we play, right?

records.jp: あはは、それいいかもしれない。<CR>それだったら続けられそうだし
records.en_original: Ahaha, I guess that could work. And it'd be good incentive to keep swimming.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I guess that could work. And it'd be good incentive to keep swimming.
records.en: Ahaha, I guess that could work.<CR>And it'd be good incentive to keep swimming.

records.jp: 伶那さん辺りに無理って論理的に説明されそうだけど
records.en_original: I get the feeling Rena would have a very logical explanation of why that would never work, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I get the feeling Rena would have a very logical explanation of why that would never work, though.
records.en: I get the feeling Rena-san would have a very logical explanation of why that would never work, though.

records.jp: まぁ、ダメならダメで普通に遊べばいいよ
records.en_original: Well, even if it doesn't, we can still play in the pool.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, even if it doesn't, we can still play in the pool.
records.en: Well, even if it doesn't, we can still play in the pool.

records.jp: それもそうだね
records.en_original: That's true!
records.en_auxiliary: That's true!
records.en: That's true!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the Fragment<CR><CLGR>%s<CLNR>.
